description: This file defines the DistributedSampler class used for distributed data loading in PyTorch, including its initialization, iteration logic, and epoch setting.

classes.name: DistributedSampler
classes.description: A sampler that restricts data loading to a subset of the dataset for distributed training.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DistributedSampler with dataset and distributed training parameters.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the indices for the current epoch, handling shuffling and data division.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of samples per epoch.

methods.name: set_epoch
methods.description: Sets the epoch number to ensure proper shuffling across epochs.
